assignmentTitle: Physics Form Two Holiday Assignment: Current Electricity, Ohm's Law & Simple Machines
subject: Physics

questionResults.questionText: Mzunguko wa umeme (circuit) una ukinzani (resistance) wa 6 Ω na unalishwa na betri ya volteji 12 V. Kulingana na Sheria ya Ohm (Ohm's Law), mkondo wa umeme (current - I) unaopita kwenye mzunguko huo ni kiasi gani?
questionResults.explanation: Ohm's Law: V = I × R => I = V / R = 12 V / 6 Ω = 2.0 Amperes (A).

questionResults.questionText: Vipingamizi viwili (resistors) vya 4 Ω na 6 Ω vimeunganishwa sambamba (in parallel). Tafuta ukinzani wa jumla (equivalent resistance, Rp).
questionResults.explanation: Kwa muungano wa sambamba: 1/Rp = 1/R1 + 1/R2 = 1/4 + 1/6 = (3 + 2)/12 = 5/12. Kwa hiyo Rp = 12/5 = 2.4 Ω.

questionResults.questionText: Mashine ina Uwiano wa Mwendo Kasi (Velocity Ratio - VR) wa 5 na ina ufanisi (Efficiency) wa 80%. Tafuta Faida ya Kimakanika (Mechanical Advantage - MA) ya mashine hiyo.
Mtu ananyanyua mzigo wa Newton 200 kwa kimo cha mita 3 ndani ya sekunde 6. Kazi (Work done) na Kani (Power) aliyotumia ni kiasi gani?
questionResults.explanation: Work = Force × Distance = 200 N × 3 m = 600 Joules. Power = Work / Time = 600 J / 6 s = 100 Watts.

assignmentTitle: Kazi ya Likizo: Kiswahili - Kidato cha Nne (Sarufi & Fasihi)
subject: Kiswahili

questionResults.questionText: Katika sentensi: 'Wanafunzi wenye bidii wamefaulu vizuri sana', neno 'vizuri' ni aina gani ya neno?
questionResults.explanation: 'Vizuri' linaeleza jinsi tendo la 'kufaulu' lilivyofanyika, kwa hiyo ni Kielezi (Adverb of manner).

questionResults.questionText: Ni kipi kati ya vifuatavyo ni kipera cha Fasihi Simulizi cha Maongezi?
questionResults.studentAnswerText: A: Hotuba na Malumbano ya Utani
questionResults.correctAnswerText: A: Hotuba na Malumbano ya Utani
questionResults.explanation: Kipera cha mazungumzo/maongezi kinajumuisha Hotuba, Malumbano ya Utani, na Ulumbi.

questionResults.questionText: Upatano wa kisarufi (Grammatical concord) katika Kiswahili hutegemea nini hasa?
questionResults.explanation: Ngeli ya nomino ndiyo huongoza viambishi vya upatano wa kisarufi katika kitenzi na vivumishi.

questionResults.questionText: Methali: 'Asiyekujua hakuthamini' inatoa funzo gani kuu?
questionResults.correctAnswerText: B: Mtu asiyejua thamani au uwezo wako hawezi kukuheshimu au kukurithisha ipasavyo
questionResults.explanation: Methali hii inafundisha kwamba asiyetambua thamani ya kitu au mtu huishia kukipuuza.

assignmentTitle: Mazoezi ya Likizo: Basic Mathematics - Kidato cha Pili
subject: Basic Mathematics

questionResults.questionText: Ikiwa gari linasafiri umbali wa kilomita 180 kwa saa 3, kasi ya wastani (Speed) ya gari hilo ni ngapi?
questionResults.explanation: Kasi (Speed) = Umbali / Muda = 180 km / 3 hrs = 60 km/h.

questionResults.questionText: Gawanya namba 240 kwa uwiano (ratio) wa 2:3. Sehemu kubwa zaidi ni ngapi?
Tafuta eneo la pembetatu yenye kitako (base) cha 12cm na kimo (height) cha 8cm.
questionResults.explanation: Eneo la pembetatu = 1/2 * kitako * kimo = 1/2 * 12 * 8 = 6 * 8 = 48 cm².

questionResults.questionText: Je, namba 29 ni namba tasa (Prime Number)?
questionResults.explanation: 29 inagawanyika kwa 1 na 29 tu bila baki, kwa hiyo ni namba tasa (Prime Number).
